scope: Current active/planned collection from /api/tasks. Inactive final rejections and expired revision holds are outside this current-hold screen. Public PR searches supplement the board review.

nearby_tasks_reviewed.title: Lock a door's deadbolt by its inside thumb-turn while pressing the door shut against its weatherstrip
nearby_tasks_reviewed.assessment: The held revision presses a door against weatherstrip and turns a deadbolt into a strike. The proposed task releases a loaded flexible chain, slides a captive head to a widened slot exit, withdraws it, and opens the door.

nearby_tasks_reviewed.title: Secure a free-standing gas cylinder to its wall bracket with the bracket's chain
nearby_tasks_reviewed.assessment: The accepted task routes a chain around an upright cylinder and hangs a link on a J-hook. The proposed task unloads an already captured slotted fitting by moving the restrained door, then extracts the fitting.

qualification: Research-fit/overlap assessment, not a guarantee of reviewer acceptance or future board availability.
